description: This file manages a compilation cache system for the Playwright project, including in-memory and disk caching, source map support, dependency tracking, and cache serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: MemoryCache
classes.description: Type representing cached code and source map paths, along with optional module URL.

classes.name: SerializedCompilationCache
classes.description: Type representing the serialized form of the entire compilation cache, including source maps, memory cache, and dependencies.

methods.name: installSourceMapSupport
methods.description: Sets up source map support for better stack traces in Node.js.

methods.name: getFromCompilationCache
methods.description: Retrieves cached code and source maps from memory or disk cache based on filename and content hash.

methods.name: serializeCompilationCache
methods.description: Serializes the current cache state for transfer or persistence.

methods.name: addToCompilationCache
methods.description: Adds cache data from a serialized cache payload into the current cache.

methods.name: stopCollectingFileDeps
methods.description: Stops collecting dependencies for a specific file.

methods.name: currentFileDepsCollector
methods.description: Returns the current dependency collector set.

methods.name: setExternalDependencies
methods.description: Sets external dependencies for a given file.

methods.name: fileDependenciesForTest
methods.description: Returns the current file dependencies map for testing.

methods.name: collectAffectedTestFiles
methods.description: Collects test files affected by a changed file based on dependencies.

methods.name: affectedTestFiles
methods.description: Returns a list of test files affected by a list of changed files.

methods.name: internalDependenciesForTestFile
methods.description: Returns internal dependencies for a specific test file.

methods.name: dependenciesForTestFile
methods.description: Returns all dependencies (internal and external) for a test file.

methods.name: belongsToNodeModules
methods.description: Checks if a file belongs to node_modules or internal playwright files.

methods.name: getUserData
methods.description: Retrieves user data associated with a plugin from cached files.
